items.name: Sao Paulo
items.pet_policy: Dogs or cats up to 33 lbs are allowed, always accompanied by their guardians.
items.parking_description: Private parking lot is available in the hotel entrance. Valet parking is available for guests and non-guests.
items.description: Experience timeless elegance at InterContinental São Paulo, where traditional luxury meets modern sophistication in the heart of the city. Just steps from Avenida Paulista, our prime location places you near historic landmarks, cultural hotspots, and São Paulo’s best shopping and dining. Whether exploring the vibrant metropolis or indulging in a moment of tranquility, you’ll find the perfect balance of city energy and refined comfort.

items.name: Sao Paulo Parque Anhembi
items.address: Rua Professor Milton Rodriguez #100, Sao Paulo, 02009-040, BR
items.pet_policy: Hotel allows 1 pet per room up to 20kg. Vaccination card required. 150 BRL fee per stay. In common areas, keep pet in lap or carrier.
items.parking_description:
Covered Parking. 
The price is subject to change without previous notice. Please contact the Hotel to get more information about the Carnaval Parking.
items.description: Welcome to the grandiose Holiday Inn São Paulo Parque Anhembi, with 780 rooms, a prime location, and exceptional service for an unforgettable stay in São Paulo. Conveniently located just a six-minute drive from Campo de Marte, and steps from Anhembi Convention Center and the Anhembi Sambadrome, we offer easy access to top attractions. Explore luxury and local shops at Shopping Center Norte and Rua 25 de Marco, watch a show or soccer game at Allianz Parque Stadium, and admire Brazilian art at the Pinacoteca de São Paulo. Attend local conferences at the nearby convention center or work with our dedicated events team to host a gathering for your colleagues. Stay active in our Fitness Center and indoor pool, dine at Camauê Restaurant and Bar du Hotel, or grab a snack from our 24-hour Convenience Center. Unwind in spacious rooms with unmatched comfort for a memorable stay in São Paulo.

items.name: Sao Paulo
items.address: Rua Bandeira Paulista, 555, Sao Paulo, 04532-011, BR
items.pet_policy: 1 pet per suite is allowed, up to 20 kg. The fee is 100 BRL plus tax per day. For long stays, minimum of 30 days in sequence, the fee is 1,000 BRL plus tax per stay. Pets must have their vaccination card up to date and cannot walk alone in common areas.
items.parking_description: Underground parking well lit with 24 hour security and video surveillance. Each guestroom has one self parking space free of charge. The parking has Sem-parar, so the guest must pick up the ticket to get it free of charge. Valet service is not available.
items.description: In the heart of Itaim Bibi, Staybridge Suites São Paulo offers the experience of living the city with more space, comfort, and freedom. With 31 floors and panoramic views, our spacious suites from 38 to 80 sqm are quiet and welcoming, featuring fully equipped kitchens and a true sense of home — ideal for short stays, mid-term projects, expats, or stays of up to one year. Work, relaxation, and leisure come together through the Work, Relax and Play concept, designed for a balanced lifestyle. Guests enjoy full facilities for productivity and well-being, including a fitness center with strength training, cardio, and classes such as yoga, Pilates, and functional training, as well as an outdoor pool with open views. Brascan Open Mall is directly connected to the hotel, just an elevator ride away, offering restaurants, cafés, a movie theater, and essential services. The location provides easy access to key business districts such as Faria Lima, Jardins, Vila Olímpia, and Paulista, as well as JK Iguatemi Shopping, Parque do Povo, and Ibirapuera Park. Pet friendly and practical for events, concerts, and trade shows, the hotel offers easy access to Allianz Parque, Morumbis, Pacaembu Stadium, and major fairs like Hospitalar. Here, São Paulo moves at your pace.
